title: Orchard: An open framework for scalable agentic AI
description: Orchard is an open-source framework for the research community to train and evaluate AI agents across task types. It reduces complexity while supporting strong performance from smaller models by enabling researchers to reuse the same infrastructure. description: Computer-use AI agents struggle with multi-step workflows like email and customer support.
